Master thesis: Learning personalized treatment strategies from longitudinal clinical data

In this 30 hp master thesis you will develop a novel machine learning method for learning personalized treatment strategies from longitudinal electronic health records. The work combines causal inference and explainable AI to support clinical decision support for diabetes patients.

We are looking for a student in data-driven health with Python skills. Location: Stockholm. Last application date: 2026-11-30
